title: Impaled Ocean
physical_identity: Endless calm saline sea dotted with wooden stilt houses and villages, drifting vessels, Deep Eye seafloor holes, and giant house-wearing Seawalkers.
scale_topology: Boundless outdoor ocean, no discernible end; seafloor 20 m down, holes to 12,000 m; houses on stilts.
anomalies: houses emerge from the sea and self-renew
snow that never melts on some roofs
Deep Eyes up to 4 km across
lighting_sound: Bright sun, blue water, calm and barely moving; gulls; constant time of day per journal.

entities.name: Seawalkers
entities.behavior: 40-70 m crab-like giants wearing stilt houses; non-aggressive; groups of 3+

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Seawalkers (non-aggressive); seagulls and fish are non-entity fauna
hazards: bridges break, stilts snap, buildings collapse

entrances.quote: The easiest way to do this is from the depths of Level 7

entrances.method: sudden sun and blue water, not recalled
entrances.quote: bright sun and blue water in a way they cannot quite recall

exits.method: multiple exits in the Deep Eyes
exits.quote: In the Deep Eyes multiple Level 8 exits were found.

exits.method: entrance in stilt houses with unmelting snow on the roof
exits.quote: there is an entrance to Level 7.7
rifts to other realities, ships of incomprehensible size

signature_mechanic: Calm endless sea in constant daylight; boats and stilt villages; dive into Deep Eyes for Level 8; non-aggressive Seawalkers wear houses.
verticality: Seabed 20 m; Deep Eye holes much deeper (up to 12,000 m); houses a few storeys.
do_not: treat the 1705 journal as article voice
conflicts_notes: Seawalkers called 'not aggressive' but also an 'unavoidable danger'. Author comment says content was cut and the author is unhappy with the page. Journal entries are in-universe fiction.
